summary: Iteration 9 tested. Backend: extended Impact with co2_saved_kg and water_saved_l returned and typed correctly by POST /api/generate-recipe (2/3 tests pass; co2_saved_kg is flaky - LLM sometimes returns 0.0 despite prompt instruction). Frontend: Favorites page correctly seeded from localStorage; favorites-totals shows all 4 metrics with Italian formatting (~3110 g / ~25,50 € / ~7,35 kg / ~1950 L). Achievements section renders all 10 tiles; 7 unlock as expected (first-recipe, food-500, save-5, food-2000, co2-2, water-500, save-25) and 3 remain locked (count-10, food-5000, co2-10) with progress bars. RecipeCard impact badge shows all 4 metrics (impact-food/savings/co2/water).

minor.issue: impact.co2_saved_kg intermittently returns 0.0 from Gemini even though the prompt asks for a positive estimate (observed ~30-50% of runs). food_saved_g / savings_eur / water_saved_l consistently populated. Consider strengthening prompt (e.g. explicit example, 'must be > 0') or a post-parse fallback estimate from food_saved_g.

issues: impact-savings uses Number(x).toFixed(2) which renders '3.00 €' with a dot, inconsistent with Italian formatting used everywhere else (totals-savings renders '25,50 €'). Should use Intl.NumberFormat('it-IT', {minimumFractionDigits:2, maximumFractionDigits:2}).

action_items: Reduce flakiness of impact.co2_saved_kg from LLM (prompt hardening or fallback derivation).
Fix Italian number formatting for impact-savings badge in RecipeCard.jsx to match totals-savings.
critical_code_review_comments: RecipeCard.jsx: numeric formatting inconsistent between impact-savings (toFixed) and totals-savings (Intl 'it-IT'). Extract a shared formatter util in /app/frontend/src/lib to avoid drift.
achievements.js is clean; consider persisting unlocked achievement IDs to localStorage so newly unlocked ones can be highlighted with an animation on next visit.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 3 recipes into localStorage 'zsc_favorites' with impact totals summing to 3110g/25.50€/7.35kg/1950L to validate totals + achievements.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 feature complete. Achievements grid uses data-testid=achievement-<id> with data-unlocked=true/false attribute. Locked tiles include a progress bar; ids: first-recipe, food-500, save-5, food-2000, co2-2, water-500, save-25, count-10, food-5000, co2-10. Backend flakiness on co2_saved_kg is worth revisiting.
rca of the issue: Backend flaky co2 field: Gemini gemini-3-flash-preview sometimes emits co2_saved_kg=0.0 despite explicit prompt guidance. Reproduction: call POST /api/generate-recipe with recovery ingredients repeatedly; ~1 in 3 responses had co2=0. Mitigation: (a) add few-shot example in prompt with numeric co2, (b) after parsing, if co2==0 derive fallback like round(food_saved_g * 0.003, 2), similarly for water_saved_l if 0.
